title: Jilïr Irpirin jan suytʼat manqʼapa
intro: Allahan Utapan qullan chiqanakanxa, Diosan mä chuymankipstat luqtiripax mä jachʼa misterio uñjäna, ukax taqi kuntï suyapkäna ukaruw jan yäqkänti. Aka Diosar katuyasiri jaqix, nayratpachaw natural awk taykjam sarnaqañ maranakatxa, mä extraordinario uñjäna, ukax Divino ukan jan tukuskir khuyapayasiñap uñacht’ayäna. Uka rompecabezas ukax profetanakan jakäwipat aka armat pacha uñt’ayañankiwa.
clues: Markajajj Israel sutimp uñtʼatäjjänwa, nayra tiempon mä jachʼa nayra awkipan wawanakapäpjjänwa.
Nayajj arumanakajajj oracionanwa sarnaqirïta, templon Tatitujan nayraqatapan qonqortʼasisaw sarnaqayäta.
Chuymanïxasax mä yuqall wawaw churapxitu, uka regalox janipuniw Allah jach’añchañ jaytkti.
Nayan yantʼatajajja, mä manqʼa jikjjatañaw utjäna, ukajj nayan uñjata mä wayna almatakiw uñstäna.
Nayax Zakariyya sat profetakïtwa, Bayt al-Maqdis sat chiqan Maryam sat warmir uñjañwa churatäna.
Uka jiskt’ar jaysäwix uka jisk’a t’aqaruw uñt’ayasi, kawkhantix Allah jupax Maryam juparux katuqatayna ukat manq’añanak churatayna.

arabic: فَتَقَبَّلَهَا رَبُّهَا بِقَبُولٍ حَسَنٍۢ وَأَنۢبَتَهَا نَبَاتًا حَسَنًۭا وَكَفَّلَهَا زَكَرِيَّا ۖ كُلَّمَا دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا زَكَرِيَّا ٱلْمِحْرَابَ وَجَدَ عِندَهَا رِزْقًۭا ۖ قَالَ يَـٰمَرْيَمُ أَنَّىٰ لَكِ هَـٰذَا ۖ قَالَتْ هُوَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
verse: So her Lord accepted her with good acceptance and caused her to grow in a good manner and put her in the care of Zechariah. Every time Zechariah entered upon her in the prayer chamber, he found with her provision. He said, "O Mary, from where is this [coming] to you?" She said, "It is from Allāh. Indeed, Allāh provides for whom He wills without account." (3:37)
